(edits message 42)
🏛 Tax rate — Ostmarch
• Tax rate: 4.5% · set by Sara (K7Q2M9A)
  ⏳ Changes to 8% in 23h

Allowed range: 0% to 25%
Default: 4.5%
A change takes effect 24h after it is announced.
After a change, the next one can be made 3d later.

New value: 8%
Adjust it with the buttons, then tap “Review change”.
  ───
  [➖ 2.5%] → gov:lever:city.tax_rate:ostmarch:550   │   [➖ 0.25%] → gov:lever:city.tax_rate:ostmarch:775   │   [➕ 0.25%] → gov:lever:city.tax_rate:ostmarch:825   │   [➕ 2.5%] → gov:lever:city.tax_rate:ostmarch:1050
  [Minimum (0%)] → gov:lever:city.tax_rate:ostmarch:0   │   [Default (4.5%)] → gov:lever:city.tax_rate:ostmarch:450   │   [Maximum (25%)] → gov:lever:city.tax_rate:ostmarch:2500
  [📝 Review change] → gov:confirm:city.tax_rate:ostmarch:800
  [🔙 Back] → gov:office   │   [🔄 Refresh] → gov:lever:city.tax_rate:ostmarch
